title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: email resolution answers customer emails without creating a case
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, prerequisites, consumption billing and documented controls are supported. Two control paths stop short of the final setting, and the rollout checklist names setup controls absent from the table; these are minor corrections. The briefing appropriately leaves the relationship between the documented Dataverse fields and the email-resolution screens unconfirmed.
